panel_note: Sanitized release seed. Replace these rows with your own board items; the board is the single store the panel and the walk both read.

items.title: Choose the first task you want BoardWalk to guide you through
items.one: Pick one real task you have been putting off, and let the walk take you to the exact place on screen where it starts. The point is to finish one thing, not to clear the board.

items.title: See what a scoped, expiring grant looks like before you issue one
items.one: Open the Grant access utility and read the exact sudoers line it would write. The release ships one no-op example capability so you can watch the whole flow without handing root to anything that does work.
items.blocks: the first real grant you want to make

items.title: Point your agent at the words on screen, not at a coordinate
items.one: Ask your agent to run bin/point-at.py see, then point "the words on screen". The overlay rings the real control; if the words are not there, the agent gets a miss, not a guess.

items.title: Take the BoardWalk feature tour (fake test item)
items.one: A safe test row. It uses the board, an authored walk, the click-through overlay, the agent's illustration and the cancel. Open Point me to there, choose feature-tour.json, and press show it on my screen.
items.blocks: nothing — it is the test itself
